title: The tunnels under the mall feel... unsafe
content: I've been to the tunnels under the mall twice, I think. I mean, I think they're under the mall. It feels like an older part of the mall, with the off-white/grey painted brick, exposed pipes, and easily accessible breaker boxes and switches. The first time I was there, I remember feeling like I wasn't alone, and skadoo'd outta there pretty fast. I think I went into an offshoot room or hall and woke up. The second time, the last time I went, the blonde guy was there. He was telling me something important about the mall and the world it was in, and I could feel myself waking up. I think he told me that this was all a dream, and I've never been adept at lucid dreaming so I started waking up. He somehow kept me there though, telling me that he wasn't safe in the Tunnels, that I wouldn't be if I left then... I know I managed to stay asleep long enough to get to an offshoot again before I woke up. (I had overslept through my alarms, which is really rare for me.) I can't remember what he was trying to tell me about the world. It's like... it's like his voice was underwater, I can remember the shapes of his mouth but the memory of it all feels muffled. I know he was crying at some point, he seemed scared. Prior to everything going muffled, we had been creeping through the tunnels and talking about our lives. I wish I could remember his name, I'm not sure if he's ever told me, every time I see him in those dreams I forget that names are important since he feels so safe and familiar. Has anyone else been to the tunnels? I think I've seen a couple of people talking about it, I figured I'd share my experiences. What do you think of them? Do you feel as weird in them as I do?
